rows.grounds: compound locative form marking the end of the tritāra root mantra
compound adjective in accusative feminine singular

items.question: What word is uttered at the end of the tritāra root mantra?
premises: The tritāra root mantra has a defined end.
items.inference: At the end of the tritāra root mantra one utters the all-god-souled word.
uncertainties: Whether padam means word, foot, or verse in this ritual context.
items.plain_english: At the end of the tritāra root mantra, utter the all-god-souled word.
